castellātim , adv. id.,
I.castle-wise: dissipati, scattered about, qs. in different fortresses, i. e. in separate detachments, Liv. 7, 36, 10: grumulis imponere allium, i. e. in clusters or hills, Plin. 19, 6, 34, § 112.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
